Exact output is proven before take; native credit is scoped/reconciled and its gate reset, and outer Manager nonReentrant plus post-settle/full end validation retain source/venue invariants.

Exact output is proven before take; native credit is scoped/reconciled and its gate reset, and outer Manager nonReentrant plus post-settle/full end validation retain source/venue invariants.
